sources.quote: Connecticut Mutual Classic (1) 1979 (New Haven, Conn.) 12/28 vs. CSU-Fullerton W, 80-69 | 12/29 at Connecticut W, 77-72
CONNECTICUT MUTUAL CLASSIC (New Haven, Conn.): Fullerton (Calif.) St., Pitt, Connecticut*, Ohio U. Dec. 28-29

note: Pitt's own media guide lists its Classic games as 12/28 (vs. Cal State Fullerton) and 12/29 (at Connecticut, 77-72), and Street & Smith's 1979-80 preseason listing gives the tournament dates as Dec. 28-29. UConn beat Ohio U. on 12/28, so the final was the next night, 12/29. Record book date is right; app's 12/30 is a day late.

truth: H (UConn-hosted Connecticut Mutual Classic, New Haven Coliseum)

sources.quote: 12/29 at Connecticut % 77 72 W ... % Connecticut Mutual Classic (New Haven, Conn.)
Fullerton (Calif.) St., Pitt, Connecticut*, Ohio U. Dec. 28-29

note: UConn was the host: Street & Smith's marks Connecticut with the host asterisk (used for every host in its holiday-tournament list), and Pitt's media guide records the final as 'at Connecticut' rather than 'vs.' The game was in New Haven, not Storrs or Hartford, so 'neutral' is defensible by venue, but by host status the record book's H matches the opponent's own designation.

sources.quote: Vaughan, who scored the winning basket against UConn to win an overtime game last season
Vaughan scored a basket with 14 seconds remaining last season to defeat the Huskies in the Field House, 72-71.

note: Pitt's own media guide (year-by-year results) lists the 2/5/1983 game at Connecticut as an OT win, 72-71, and the UConn student paper's previews/recaps a year later describe Clyde Vaughan's winner in last season's overtime game. Record book (OT) is right; app is missing the OT. Side note: the Daily Campus places this game at the UConn Field House in Storrs, not the Hartford Civic Center.

sources.quote: Connecticut Daily Campus, Monday, February 6, 1984 ... Tonight the Huskies face a squad
After losing its fourth straight Big East game to Pittsburgh last night

note: Pitt's media guide lists the game on 2/6 (Monday); the Feb 6, 1984 Daily Campus previews it as 'tonight' (8 p.m., Field House) and the Tuesday Feb 7 issue recaps it as 'last night'. Record book date (2/6) is right; app's 2/8 is wrong. Venue per Daily Campus was the UConn Field House in Storrs (attendance 3,985), not the Hartford Civic Center. (The guide's OCR text reads '(0OT)' for '(OT)'.)

sources.quote: Vaughn scores 29; Huskies fall in OT ... the Huskies took the game into overtime before losing, 75-71

note: Pitt's media guide marks the game OT, and the next-day Daily Campus recap and box (Pitt 37-25-13, UConn 35-27-9; 62-62 after regulation) confirm overtime. Record book (OT) is right; app is missing the OT. (The guide's OCR text reads '(0OT)' for '(OT)'.)

sources.quote: at No. 10 Connecticut Storrs, Conn. (Gampel Pavilion) L, 80-82 (OT) Jan 6 (Sat)
Huskies outscored St. John's 7-5 in the extra period en route to an 82-80 victory Saturday.

note: St. John's official 2000-01 schedule archive marks the game L 80-82 (OT), and the AP recap on ESPN (STORRS dateline) says Caron Butler's buzzer 3 forced overtime, which UConn won 7-5. App (OT) is right; the record book season page omits the OT mark that its own OT list and series history carry.

sources.quote: Miami 68-70 vs. Connecticut ... Wed, Jan. 20 (1999) ... result: loss, text: (OT)

note: Miami's official athletics site (schedule event 12979, 1999-01-20 at Miami, Fla.) stores the result as a loss with result text '(OT)', 70-68. App (OT) is right; the record book season page omits the OT mark that its own OT list and Miami series history carry. Second independent source still being sought.

sources.quote: vs Connecticut East Rutherford, N.J. NCAA Tournament W, 79-78 (OT) Mar 24 (Sat)
Blue Devils Win at the Buzzer in OT, 79-78

note: Duke's official 1989-90 schedule archive marks the regional final W 79-78 (OT), and the Washington Post Service report in the IHT (Mar 26 1990) describes Laettner's buzzer-beater in the final seconds of overtime.
